description: On the south shore of Lac Bay the lagoon is dark under a clear sky, with mangrove silhouettes and a pale sand edge. A bright moon leaves a thin reflection on the water, and a few distant lights sit on the far shore. It is about 28.4°C, with wind near 22.9 km/h and cloud cover about 8%. The salt pans are a different shore and are not in this frame.
